n81cb5594b1.headline: Škoda Auto will extend production shutdown by another week due to chip shortage
n81cb5594b1.summary: Škoda Auto will not resume production after its company-wide vacation in early August due to ongoing semiconductor supply shortages.
n81cb5594b1.why: Škoda Auto is a major Czech automobile manufacturer whose production disruptions reflect the global chip shortage impacting the automotive industry worldwide.
